experiment: VM-cached stack origin and logical frame limit for trampoline calls
hypothesis: Capture the active thread stack origin at interpreter entry; check current stack distance and logical guest-frame depth in the VM before a trampoline frame push, without per-call TLS access or StackGuard Drop bookkeeping.
decision_reason: The CJS call loop retired 0.778% fewer instructions but had a 0.451% median cycle increase (95% paired bootstrap interval -1.394% to +1.053%) and 1.053% median elapsed increase. The unrelated local-store control moved +5.407% in cycles and +8.0% elapsed, so it dominates the microbench delta. On Richards, cycles were effectively flat while median Score fell 1.255%; DeltaBlue had a 0.650% median cycle improvement whose 95% interval included zero and no median Score change. Fixture outcomes are small and inconsistent, so there is no reliable task-relevant speed win. The mechanism is not rejected as slower because control movement exceeded the target effect; the source candidate is not retained pending a less layout-sensitive hypothesis or measurement.

host.resource_limits: No container memory or CPU quota reported

build.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/candidate-b CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_PRODUCTION_STRIP=symbols cargo build --locked --offline --profile production -p quench-node --bin quench-node

preliminary_screen.note: Three-pair screening showed target instructions down 0.8% with cycles up 0.7% to 1.1%; control cycles moved up 1.1% to 4.5%, so the screen proceeded to the 11-pair gate.

microbench.method: 11 alternating Quench-only pairs per target/control, CJS-shaped scripts, /usr/bin/time -l; paired bootstrap interval over median percentage delta

fixtures.method: 11 alternating Quench-only pairs per V8-v7 fixture, materialized base.js plus fixture plus benchmark runner; exact observable output match checked each pair

test262.stage_48_function: 508/509; the sole failure was reproduced on clean baseline revision 974d31f09 with the identical message

correctness.node_oracle: RangeError class, message and recovery matched baseline and Node --jitless for the stack-exhaustion probe; the separate Test262 Function realm failure is pre-existing and local Node passes it

follow_up: The earlier single-TLS-cell measurement remains separately classified as inconclusive. This no-TLS VM-cached mechanism was tested independently and its candidate source was removed because fixture-level cycles and Score did not demonstrate a reliable gain.
